objectives.description: Describe the concept of society and explain the roles of family as the basic social unit
Identify core national values including honesty, discipline, respect for elders, and tolerance and explain their importance
Discuss gender roles in traditional and modern Nigerian society and advocate for gender equality
Explain the importance of work, the dignity of labour, and the social value of different occupations
Describe self-control and discipline as essential values in school, family, and community life
Explain the meaning and importance of citizenship and identify the qualities of a good citizen
Describe the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR) and explain the rights of children under the Child Rights Act
Explain citizens' duties and responsibilities including respect for rule of law and participation in civic processes
Identify human rights institutions in Nigeria (NHRC, Legal Aid Council, NGOs) and explain their roles
Describe the African Charter on Human and Peoples' Rights and explain its relevance to Nigerian citizens
Explain the principles of democracy, rule of law, and the importance of free and fair elections
Describe the qualities of good leadership and give examples from Nigerian history
Explain the meaning and effects of corruption and describe the roles of anti-corruption agencies (EFCC, ICPC)
Explain the meaning of peace and describe strategies for conflict prevention and resolution in communities
Describe civic participation methods including voting, volunteering, and expressing public opinion
Explain the meaning and indicators of national development and the roles of citizens in achieving it
Describe environmental citizenship practices including sanitation, waste management, and conservation
Explain economic values including thrift, saving, investment, and entrepreneurship as drivers of development
Identify the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and explain how Nigerian citizens can contribute to them
Describe civic challenges in Nigeria and Africa (poverty, illiteracy, unemployment, governance failures) and suggest solutions
Explain the importance of national integration and unity in Nigeria's diverse multicultural society
